column7: All 5 sites are ordinary `if (!parseValidPostControlFlowToken(peek))` guards on the production control-flow body paths. The callee takes ONE argument and returns an int used only in a boolean context. A scalar PolyC delegate with signature (I64 present, I64 kind, I64 value) -> I64 can be substituted at each site without moving any parser state machine.
Production already delegates to BootstrapCalcPadding under HCC_USE_SELFHOST_PARSER_PADDING (src/parser.c:431-453). ALREADY_SELFHOSTED => CAND-002_SELECTED_AGAIN=FORBIDDEN.

column4: parseClassDef -> parseClassOrUnion (passed as the `computeSize` function pointer)
column7: The single call site is a FUNCTION-POINTER argument (u32 (*computeSize)(List *)). Migrating it would require changing the callback contract of parseClassOrUnion and would have to carry the `type->offset` side effect across the boundary, which is a host-graph WRITE (R0=4). Not bridgeable.

No production call site exists for a size-only sub-slice. To create one would require a new callback contract in parseClassOrUnion (a production API change) and would duplicate the alignment walk. Not bridgeable in the successor's scope.

column4: parseUnionDef -> parseClassOrUnion (passed as the `computeSize` function pointer)
column7: The single call site is a function-pointer argument with the signature u32 (*computeSize)(List *). The function body is read-only, so a bounded PolyC delegate over a copied (size) sequence is conceivable, BUT the callback ABI carries a List* and the host would have to materialise the copied sequence on every call. The delegation requires changing a production callback contract. R0=0 but the production seam is narrower than CAND-001's.
